'''Jennet Cobb''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jennet Cobb}}

==Appearance and Personality==
She is 5' 4 1/2" or 164&nbsp;cm tall, with dark red hair flowing down her back, and green eyes. She is not beautiful, but most men would think her pretty except that her manner is reserved. Not cool, but private and very self-contained. 

Despite this outward appearance, she has a considerable temper. She learned to control it during her time as a novice, although it was not easy for her. It could flare, however, especially over what she perceived as injustice.

==Strength and Abilities==
Jennet is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|24}}. She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to [[Traveling|Travel]]. 

==History== 
Jennet was born in {{ne|851}}. Her parents were innkeepers of the Queen's Blessing in Caemlyn. Jennet had three sisters and two brothers. [[Basel Gill]] is descended from one of her brothers.

She went to the White Tower in {{ne|866}} at the age of 15. 

She spent 10 years as a novice and 9 as Accepted and was raised to the shawl in {{ne|885}} at the age of 34.

At the end of the Aiel War, Sheriam says that Jennet has told her the Aiel are in retreat {{ref/book|0|6}}.

She expressed reservations over Siuan being raised Amyrlin so young.

==Activities==

After the split in the Tower, she joins the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]].

She, along with nine others, is sent as a mole to the [[White Tower]] to spread rumors about the [[Red Ajah]]'s involvement with inducing [[Logain]] to declare himself as the [[Dragon Reborn]]{{ref/book|7|8}}{{ref/book|8|26}}.

[[Zerah Dacan]] is forced to reveal her name as a rebel spy to [[Pevara Tazanovni]] and [[Seaine Herimon]]. Like all in that group, she is not a Darkfriend.

She has been warned by [[Beonin Marinye]] that [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] is aware of her being a spy{{ref/book|11|24}}.

When the oath of obedience is removed from [[Meidani Eschede|Meidani]], it can be assumed that Jennet was freed as well.
